items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid, secondary, outline, ghost, link and destructive buttons with a loading state and asChild for links.
items.docs: Use asChild to render the styles on a Next Link. loading disables the button and shows a spinner.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status and metadata labels with success, warning, destructive, outline and muted tones.
items.docs: Status badges carry text as well as colour; never rely on the tone alone.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the shape of the content, with a shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Give siblings a delay so the sweep runs as one wave.
items.docs: Match the real layout: a skeleton that does not hold the final shape shifts the page when the data arrives.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key for shortcut hints, with a group for combinations.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with focus ring, invalid state and file input styling.
items.docs: Pair with Label via htmlFor. Set aria-invalid from your form library to show the error state. fieldSurface is the same surface for Textarea and the Select and Combobox triggers.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label that focuses its control on click.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip on hover and focus, with a shared provider so a row of controls feels like one surface.
items.docs: Wrap your app once in TooltipProvider. A tooltip is never the only place a label lives.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with focus trap, Escape and backdrop close, and a required title and description.
items.docs: Every DialogContent needs a DialogTitle; hide it visually with sr-only if the design has no heading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge: menus, carts, filters. Same accessibility contract as Dialog.
items.docs: Pass side left, right, top or bottom. Sheets slide on transform only.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with arrow-key navigation, as an underline (line) or a segmented control (pill).
items.docs: Give TabsList the group/list class so the triggers pick up the variant.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A filtered, keyboard-driven list on cmdk, inline or as a palette in CommandDialog.
items.docs: CommandDialog brings its own Command root: put CommandInput and CommandList straight inside. It carries a hidden title and description for screen readers.

items.name: rhs-ui-theme
items.title: RHS UI theme
items.description: The RHS UI colour theme: a violet brand ramp on a constant OKLCH hue and a violet-tinted neutral scale, measured for WCAG AA in light and dark. Drops into any shadcn project as the semantic tokens.
items.docs: Installs the RHS semantic tokens into your globals.css. Your components keep their names (bg-background, text-primary); only the values change.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Keyboard-friendly disclosure rows with single or multiple expanded items.

items.name: accordion-demo
items.title: accordion demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the accordion component.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible binary switch with form support and controlled or uncontrolled state.

items.name: switch-demo
items.title: switch demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the switch component.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: An accessible value or range slider with keyboard controls and labelled thumbs.

items.name: slider-demo
items.title: slider demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the slider component.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox with a visible box at rest, a check and an indeterminate dash, keyboard and form support.
items.docs: Set checked="indeterminate" on a parent whose children are partly chosen. With a name it submits like a native checkbox.

items.name: checkbox-demo
items.title: checkbox demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the checkbox component.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice out of a few: arrow keys move and choose, the circle is visible at rest.
items.docs: Name the group with aria-label or a fieldset legend. Wrap an item and its text in a Label to make the whole row clickable.

items.name: radio-group-demo
items.title: radio group demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the radio group component.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select on the field surface with our own listbox: groups, a second line per option, typeahead, never the browser menu.
items.docs: Opens under the field (position popper). With a name, Radix keeps a hidden, aria-hidden native select in sync for FormData and autofill; nobody sees or reaches it.

items.name: select-demo
items.title: select demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the select component.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that opens a searchable list, for choices too long to scan: countries, time zones, customers.
items.docs: Search matches the label and the keywords. With a name, a hidden input carries the value; validate required in your form schema.

items.name: combobox-demo
items.title: combobox demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the combobox component.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field on the same surface as Input that grows with its text where the browser supports it.
items.docs: Uses field-sizing: content; older browsers fall back to rows and the resize handle.

items.name: textarea-demo
items.title: textarea demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the textarea component.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel anchored to its trigger for a small form or filters. Exports the panel surface every floating layer shares.
items.docs: Focus moves in on open and back on close. panelSurface keeps Select, Dropdown menu and Combobox on the same panel.

items.name: popover-demo
items.title: popover demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the popover component.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions: shortcuts, toggles, a choice of one, submenus and a destructive item, fully keyboard driven.
items.docs: For actions only. Navigation between pages belongs in links, not a menu.

items.name: command-demo
items.title: command demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the command component, inline and as a palette.

items.name: dropdown-menu-demo
items.title: dropdown menu demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the dropdown menu component.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short notices with a toast() call and one Toaster: tones, an action, swipe to dismiss, pause on hover, F8 to reach them.
items.docs: Mount one Toaster near the root and call toast() from any event handler. Reuse an id to turn Saving into Saved.

items.name: toast-demo
items.title: toast demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the toast component.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts with a caption, its own horizontal scroll and a sortable header that sets aria-sort.
items.docs: Give TableHead sort and onSort to make it a sort button. Mark a selected row with data-state="selected".

items.name: table-demo
items.title: table demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the table component.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface for one piece of content: header with title, description and action, content and footer.
items.docs: CardTitle is an h3; pass asChild with your own heading when the outline needs another level.

items.name: card-demo
items.title: card demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the card component.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or workspace as a circle: the image when it loads, initials when it does not, and overlapping groups.
items.docs: initialsOf(name) gives the fallback letters. Give AvatarImage an alt, or alt="" when the name is written next to it.

items.name: avatar-demo
items.title: avatar demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the avatar component.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate or indeterminate progress bar that holds still under reduced motion.
items.docs: Name it with aria-label or aria-labelledby. Pass getValueLabel for an answer like "2 of 5 files".

items.name: progress-demo
items.title: progress demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the progress component.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Links between pages with a fixed-width page range, the current page marked and Previous and Next kept readable.
items.docs: paginationRange(current, total) returns the pages and gaps to draw. Pass asChild to render your router's link.

items.name: pagination-demo
items.title: pagination demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the pagination component.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits: an ordered list of links ending in the current page, with collapsible middle crumbs.
items.docs: The last crumb is BreadcrumbPage (aria-current, not a link). Separators are hidden from screen readers.

items.name: breadcrumb-demo
items.title: breadcrumb demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the breadcrumb component.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with panels in one shared viewport that resizes between them, on hover and keyboard.
items.docs: Set viewport={false} and place NavigationMenuViewport yourself when the panel must sit elsewhere, like under a full-width header.

items.name: navigation-menu-demo
items.title: navigation menu demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the navigation menu component.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stays until its cause is gone: notice, success, warning or error, with an optional icon.
items.docs: Tone is carried by the words and the icon as well as the colour. It is a status by default; pass role="alert" only for something that just happened and needs attention now.

items.name: alert-demo
items.title: Alert demo
items.description: A working preview of Alert.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A question that must be answered first: delete, discard, leave. Focus starts on the safe answer.
items.docs: Name the action on the button ("Delete project", not "OK"). It does not close on an outside click.

items.name: alert-dialog-demo
items.title: Alert Dialog demo
items.description: A working preview of Alert Dialog.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview that appears when the pointer rests on a link: a profile, a repository, a product.
items.docs: A bonus for pointer users: never the only way to reach the information.

items.name: hover-card-demo
items.title: Hover Card demo
items.description: A working preview of Hover Card.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: The menu behind a right click or Shift+F10: actions on the thing under the pointer.
items.docs: Everything in it must also be reachable another way; nobody discovers a right click by looking.

items.name: context-menu-demo
items.title: Context Menu demo
items.description: A working preview of Context Menu.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop app's row of menus (File, Edit, View) with submenus, toggles and a choice of one.
items.docs: For a website's navigation use navigation-menu.

items.name: menubar-demo
items.title: Menubar demo
items.description: A working preview of Menubar.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One section that opens and closes, its height animated, instantly under reduced motion.
items.docs: For a list of sections use accordion.

items.name: collapsible-demo
items.title: Collapsible demo
items.description: A working preview of Collapsible.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed (bold, pin, mute) and announces its state.
items.docs: An icon-only toggle needs an aria-label that names the action, not the state.

items.name: toggle-demo
items.title: Toggle demo
items.description: A working preview of Toggle.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Toggles joined into one control: one of them, or any of them. Arrow keys move between items.
items.docs: Give the group an aria-label.

items.name: toggle-group-demo
items.title: Toggle Group demo
items.description: A working preview of Toggle Group.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrolling box with a slim scrollbar that matches the interface, scrolling itself stays native.
items.docs: Give it a height. The viewport takes focus so the keyboard can scroll it.

items.name: scroll-area-demo
items.title: Scroll Area demo
items.description: A working preview of Scroll Area.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A box that keeps its proportions at any width and reserves the space before media loads.

items.name: aspect-ratio-demo
items.title: Aspect Ratio demo
items.description: A working preview of Aspect Ratio.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Work without a measurable end: twelve ticks fading in turn, a slow pulse under reduced motion.
items.docs: Prefer a skeleton when you know the shape of what is coming. Pass label="" when a visible label beside it already says what is loading.

items.name: spinner-demo
items.title: Spinner demo
items.description: A working preview of Spinner.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A field with something attached (a unit, a prefix, an icon) that takes the focus ring as one.

items.name: input-group-demo
items.title: Input Group demo
items.description: A working preview of Input Group.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search field with a magnifier, a clear button, Escape to clear and an optional key hint.
items.docs: Give it a label, visible or as aria-label. The shortcut hint is display only: bind the key yourself.

items.name: search-input-demo
items.title: Search Input demo
items.description: A working preview of Search Input.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with show and hide, and for a new password the rules it must meet, ticked off live.
items.docs: Set autoComplete to current-password or new-password so password managers help.

items.name: password-input-demo
items.title: Password Input demo
items.description: A working preview of Password Input.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A number with minus and plus: arrow keys step, Page keys step by ten, typing is checked on leave.

items.name: number-input-demo
items.title: Number Input demo
items.description: A working preview of Number Input.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code in boxes: typing moves on, Backspace moves back, pasting fills them all.
items.docs: The first box carries autocomplete="one-time-code", so phones offer the code from the message.

items.name: otp-input-demo
items.title: OTP Input demo
items.description: A working preview of OTP Input.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Several short values in one field: Enter or a comma adds, Backspace removes, duplicates are refused.

items.name: tag-input-demo
items.title: Tag Input demo
items.description: A working preview of Tag Input.

items.name: form-field
items.title: Form Field
items.description: Label, control, hint and error wired together for assistive technology, with any form library.
items.docs: Pass your form library's error as error and set described when a FormDescription is present.

items.name: form-field-demo
items.title: Form Field demo
items.description: A working preview of Form Field.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Stars to give a score (a radio group underneath) or to show one, in words for screen readers.

items.name: rating-demo
items.title: Rating demo
items.description: A working preview of Rating.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A colour from swatches (a radio group) or typed as a hex code, behind a trigger showing it.

items.name: color-picker-demo
items.title: Color Picker demo
items.description: A working preview of Color Picker.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month to pick a day from: a keyboard grid, limits and blocked days, names from the locale.
items.docs: Pass locale for your readers; it defaults to en-GB so the server and the browser draw the same month. Today is marked only in the browser.

items.name: calendar-demo
items.title: Calendar demo
items.description: A working preview of Calendar.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A day behind a field-like trigger: the calendar opens in a panel, picking closes it.

items.name: date-picker-demo
items.title: Date Picker demo
items.description: A working preview of Date Picker.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: Drop files or click to choose, with type and size checks and a list to remove them again.
items.docs: A real file input underneath: keyboard and screen readers get the native control.

items.name: file-dropzone-demo
items.title: File Dropzone demo
items.description: A working preview of File Dropzone.

items.name: stepper

items.name: stepper-demo
items.title: Stepper demo
items.description: A working preview of Stepper.

items.name: tree-view

items.name: tree-view-demo
items.title: Tree View demo

items.name: carousel-demo
items.title: Carousel demo
items.description: A working preview of Carousel.

items.name: banner

items.description: A working preview of Banner.

items.name: sidebar-nav

items.name: country-select
items.title: Country select
items.description: A country picker on the house combobox, never a native select: every country named in the reader's language by the browser, with its flag, a search that also matches the ISO code, your most common countries on top, and the code submitted through a hidden input.

items.name: country-select-demo
items.title: Country select demo
items.description: A working preview of Country select.

items.description: "2026-04-14T10:30" from the parts, or "" while either is missing.

items.title: Date time picker demo
items.description: A working preview of Date time picker.

items.name: month-picker
items.title: Month picker
items.description: Pick a month, not a day: for reports, billing periods and card expiry.

items.name: month-picker-demo
items.title: Month picker demo
items.description: A working preview of Month picker.

items.name: feature-badge
items.title: Feature badge
items.description: The little "New", "Beta" or "Soon" next to a menu item or a button, so people notice what changed without a tour.

items.name: feature-badge-demo
items.title: Feature badge demo
items.description: A working preview of Feature badge.

items.name: scroll-tabs
items.title: Scroll tabs
items.description: Many tabs on a narrow screen: one row that scrolls sideways with fade edges and arrow buttons that appear only when there is more to see.

items.name: scroll-tabs-demo
items.title: Scroll tabs demo

items.name: breadcrumb-collapsed
items.title: Breadcrumb collapsed
items.description: A breadcrumb for deep paths: the first crumb and the last few stay, the middle folds into a "…" menu with every hidden level as a link, so a path ten folders deep still fits one line on a phone.

items.name: breadcrumb-collapsed-demo
items.title: Breadcrumb collapsed demo
items.description: A working preview of Breadcrumb collapsed.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip link
items.description: The first thing in the page for keyboard users: "Skip to content", hidden until it gets focus, then shown top left above everything, and it moves focus to the main content (give that element tabIndex={-1}).

items.name: skip-link-demo
items.title: Skip link demo
items.description: A working preview of Skip link.

items.name: pager-nav
items.title: Pager nav
items.description: Previous and next at the end of a doc page, a lesson or a blog series: two cards with the direction, the title and an arrow that nudges on hover.

items.name: pager-nav-demo
items.title: Pager nav demo
items.description: A working preview of Pager nav.

items.name: mobile-menu
items.title: Mobile menu
items.description: The phone navigation of a marketing site: a menu button that opens a full screen panel with big tap targets, groups that fold open in place, the current page marked and the main actions pinned to the bottom.

items.name: mobile-menu-demo
items.title: Mobile menu demo
items.description: A working preview of Mobile menu.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet for phones: slides up from the edge, has a grab handle you can drag down to dismiss (past a third of its height or a quick flick), and is a real modal dialog underneath, so focus is trapped and Escape and the backdrop close it.

items.name: drawer-demo
items.title: Drawer demo
items.description: A working preview of Drawer.

items.name: file-trigger
items.title: File trigger
items.description: A single file field that looks like the rest of the form: a button to choose, then the file's name and size with a remove button, and a refusal in words when it is too big.

items.name: file-trigger-demo
items.title: File trigger demo
items.description: A working preview of File trigger.

items.name: checkbox-cards
items.title: Checkbox cards
items.description: Pick several from a few rich options: interests, add-ons, integrations to install.

items.name: checkbox-cards-demo
items.title: Checkbox cards demo
items.description: A working preview of Checkbox cards.

items.name: duration-input
items.title: Duration input
items.description: A duration as hours and minutes (and days if you want them), each its own small number field under one group label, so nobody has to type "1:30" or "90" and guess the unit.

items.name: duration-input-demo
items.title: Duration input demo
items.description: A working preview of Duration input.

items.name: unit-input
items.title: Unit input
items.description: A number with its unit as one field: weight in kg or lb, size in px or %, a timeout in seconds or minutes.

items.name: unit-input-demo
items.title: Unit input demo
items.description: A working preview of Unit input.

items.name: term-tooltip
items.title: Term tooltip
items.description: Jargon explained in place: the term gets a dotted underline and opens a short definition on click, tap or Enter (not on hover alone, so it works on phones and for keyboards), with a link to the glossary.

items.name: term-tooltip-demo
items.title: Term tooltip demo
items.description: A working preview of Term tooltip.

items.name: empty-search
items.title: Empty search
items.description: The "no results" state that helps: it repeats what was searched, shows the filters that narrowed it to nothing with one button to clear them, offers close searches, and ends with a way to a human.

items.name: empty-search-demo
items.title: Empty search demo
items.description: A working preview of Empty search.

items.name: inline-confirm

items.name: vertical-tabs
items.title: Vertical tabs
items.description: Tabs down the side for settings pages and long forms: a vertical tablist (up and down arrows move) beside the panel, each tab with an icon and an optional line, collapsing to a horizontal scroll row on a phone.

items.description: The search field in a header that is really a button: it opens your command palette, shows the right shortcut for the platform (⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl K elsewhere, worked out after load so the server and browser agree), and listens for that shortcut anywhere on the page.

items.name: search-trigger-demo

items.description: A working preview of Search trigger.
